kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتهايأ (form VI)
# نَتَهَايَأُ (natahāyaʔu) /na.ta.haː.ja.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَهَايَأَ (tahāyaʔa)
# نَتَهَايَأَ (natahāyaʔa) /na.ta.haː.ja.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَهَايَأَ (tahāyaʔa)
# نَتَهَايَأْ (natahāyaʔ) /na.ta.haː.jaʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَهَايَأَ (tahāyaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
